cover_letter_text:
Hello,
I am applying for the Site Engineer - Urban Development - EOI 2027 role advertised on SEEK. Your advert says the Urban Development team delivers civil infrastructure across subdivisions, council projects and associated development works.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day and tracked progress. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements, and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with site inspections, daily coordination and quality checks. I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage.

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a call?
Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
questions.answer: Subclass 485 Temporary Graduate visa with full working rights until December 2027. No sponsorship needed.

questions.question: Do you hold a Construction Induction Safety certificate (White Card)?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
